candidateSigmaEffExtractionLemma.claimLevel: priority-only conditional extraction lemma; accepts no source rows and does not prove accepted_sigma_eff_extraction
candidateSigmaEffExtractionLemma.statement: If one retained confinement-functional record supplies the accepted K_perp, V_exc, rho_NS, chi_sea, axis_exceptionality_charge, and same_record_noether_sea_response rows, an admissible same-domain class A_sigma(Q) with fixed color-charge and Noether sea boundary data, compactness for minimizing sequences, a lower-bounded coercive extraction functional S_sigma, a minimizer (a_*, f_*), a stationarity residual within epsilon_ref, and refinement stability |sigma_eff^(h)-sigma_eff^(h/2)| <= epsilon_ref, then the packet has the certificate shape needed to support accepted_sigma_eff_extraction.

proofSteps.derivation: Use the accepted input rows only to define the same retained domain for S_sigma; do not treat those inputs as the accepted sigma_eff extraction.
A lower-bounded coercive S_sigma over a compact same-domain admissible class gives a minimizing sequence with a convergent subsequence and a minimizer (a_*, f_*).
The minimizer must satisfy delta_{a,f} S_sigma[a_*,f_*]=0 within epsilon_ref in the same retained record.
The extracted value must obey |sigma_eff^(h)-sigma_eff^(h/2)| <= epsilon_ref, preventing a grid-only or sample-only row from becoming accepted evidence.

The certificate path must name the accepted upstream rows, the same-domain minimizer or variational certificate, and the refinement-stable sigma_eff row before any toy coefficient can consume sigma_eff_extraction.
